newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate edges down to 5.48 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate edges down to 5.48 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills edged lower to 5.48 percent from 5.49 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price rose to 98.635 from 98.632 a week earlier and the minimum price accepted was 98.629.
Banks submitted bids for 29.2 million dinars worth of bills, up from 26.6 million dinars the previous week.
The bills are offered on Monday and issued on Wednesday.
